scripts.script:
The tomb awakens.

Ancient mechanisms grind to life beneath your feet. Walls that have stood unmoving for millennia begin to shift, sealing passages and opening others deeper within the crypt.

Somewhere beyond this maze of living metal lies your escape.

Move quickly.

The tomb is already changing around you.

The way forward is sealed.

Ancient hatchways and reinforced breach points divide the crypt into a maze of locked chambers. Somewhere beyond them, the tomb continues to awaken.

You will have to make your own path.

Break open enough of the sealed network to force a route through.

And do it before the tomb closes around you.

A signal flickers somewhere within the crypt.

Weak. Intermittent. Buried beneath layers of living metal and ancient interference.

Several locations could conceal the transponder, but only one contains what you came for.

Find it.

Then get the carrier out of the Tomb World before the signal disappears with them.

At the heart of the crypt, the sarcophagus pulses with dormant power.

Damage already scars its surface, but the tomb is repairing what has been broken. Living metal flows across ancient wounds as systems buried beneath the chamber stir to life.

Destroy it before the crypt can restore itself.

Whatever sleeps inside must never awaken.

The sub-crypt is silent.

No movement. No active defenders. Only sealed chambers stretching away into the darkness.

But the silence feels deliberate.

Every unopened room may conceal systems that have not yet realized you are here.

Push deeper. Clear the chambers. Learn what lies beneath the tomb.

And be ready when it notices you.

The tomb has broken your formation.

Phasing pathways twist through the complex, carrying warriors through impossible routes and depositing them far from where they intended to go.

Your team is scattered.

Navigate the shifting network. Reach the far side of the crypt.

Then bring the survivors back together before the tomb isolates them for good.
